source_classes.portable_product_references: authorized operating documentation from a separate business repository

source_revision_policy: Verify the authorized source revision privately during each refresh; do not publish its path, remote, or fingerprint.
publication_boundary: No source tenant configuration, identifiers, records, code, routes, aliases, screenshots, payloads, logs, or private artifacts are included.
configured_session_scope: Historical Sylvara-only role membership, prefix-free catalog operation keys, and annotations from a supplied Codex surface export, cross-checked against the callable-tool registry available on the observation date without invoking Zoho; the later refreshed Books and CRM capabilities and scoped acceptance evidence are recorded separately.
transformations: Rewritten as Sylvara reference documentation rather than copied verbatim.
Removed all source-business fields, modules, workflows, business rules, examples, identifiers, routes, aliases, and decisions.
Retained portable product behavior, generic reliability controls, and official-source links.
Separated each configured operation key from its prefix-free human annotation; product or server prefixes are not part of annotated tool names.
Refreshed portable CRM, Creator, Forms, Contracts, Sign, Checkout, and Flow field-type contracts against current official sources.
Marked Sylvara adoption and effective tenant access unknown except for the separately recorded bounded Books chart and CRM schema capabilities verified on 2026-08-05.
Separated reusable references from Sylvara operating standards and live configuration.

Books automations, financial records, account mappings, and accounting decisions
